## Contributor checklist

<!-- Please confirm each item. Leave clinical items unchecked and explain if a
PR is non-clinical (e.g. tooling only). -->

- [ ] **Species-awareness confirmed.** Every clinical claim accounts for species
      differences; the skill requires or accounts for species identification.
- [ ] **Every clinical claim is cited.** No dose, value, prevalence, or
      recommendation is stated without a supporting reference.
- [ ] **Sources are listed** (see the Sources section below): textbooks (with
      edition), guidelines/consensus statements, formularies, or primary literature.
- [ ] **No fabrication.** Where data is limited, the text says so rather than
      inventing dosing, statistics, or recommendations.
- [ ] **Follows the SKILL-TEMPLATE format** (YAML frontmatter with `name` and
      `description`; Overview, When to Use, Workflow, Limitations at minimum).
      _(Skip for non-skill PRs.)_
- [ ] **Not a substitute for veterinary judgment.** Content is framed as an AI
      reasoning reference reviewed by a licensed veterinarian, not as
      patient-specific diagnosis or treatment.
